cards.name: Соло@uk
cards.author: Гайдук Анна@uk
cards.description: A step-by-step touch typing course: from your first keys to confident typing.
features: A final check without the on-screen keyboard or hints: you need 3 successful attempts in a row.
The accuracy threshold is visible before you start; the speed and accuracy formulas are shown in the interface.
Progress is saved in your browser.
cards.alt: Illustration: hands on the home row, with steps made of keys leading to a sheet of text and three marks for successful attempts.

cards.name: Typing-Race
cards.author: prodelt · GitHub
cards.description: A learning system with finger hints, detailed analytics and races with friends.
features: After each exercise: errors by character, your slowest transition, rhythm and advice on what to practice next.
Races in a private room joined by code, with your opponent’s live progress and a leaderboard.
Themes, text size up to 40 px and a reduced-motion mode.
cards.alt: Illustration: three cars on a race track next to an analytics card with charts and a keyboard highlighting mistakes.

cards.name: TypTap
cards.author: Артем · artyd@uk
cards.description: A trainer with mini-games and multiplayer: learning that easily turns into a game.
features: 16 mini-games and a single-text race for up to 8 players.
The “Weak keys” mode picks exercises based on your mistakes.
Your own text: paste it or upload a .txt or .md file.
cards.alt: Illustration: eight smiling player characters above four mini-games made of keys.

cards.name: Гами@uk
cards.author: apteka95video-source · GitHub
cards.description: Exercises like piano scales: a short movement, one goal and new difficulty only once you have mastered the last step.
features: A final check without the keyboard or hints, an accuracy threshold of 95–97%, 3 successful attempts in a row.
Error breakdown, slowest transitions, a rhythm chart and a “Weak spots” exercise.
Works offline as an app (PWA) and sends nothing over the network.
cards.alt: Illustration: a finger pressing keys that rise like a piano scale, with a musical staff above them.

cards.name: Touch Type Race Academy
cards.author: Stanislav Zubar і Myroslav Zubar@uk
cards.description: A large trainer with races: solo, against a bot or online, in three languages.
features: “Solo”, “Against AI” (4 bot speeds) and “Online” modes, with rooms for 2, 4 or 6 players.
Ukrainian, English and Polish; up to six profiles on one computer.
Post-race analytics, a daily practice counter and achievements.
cards.alt: Illustration: three cars in flag colors racing down a road, with a robot holding a checkered flag and an online-game globe beside them.
